description: This file declares the CasimirController class, which provides an interface for controlling RF features such as connecting over TCP/Unix socket, muting, unmuting, setting power levels, broadcasting RF signals, polling NFC, and transmitting APDU commands. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and includes methods for RF communication and NFC operations.

classes.name: CasimirController
classes.description: Provides methods for RF and NFC control, including connection setup, signaling, and data exchange.

methods.name: ConnectToTcpPort
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a TCP port for RF communication.

methods.name: ConnectToUnixSocket
methods.description: Establishes a connection via a Unix socket for RF communication.

methods.name: SendBroadcast
methods.description: Sends a broadcast RF signal with specified parameters.

methods.name: Poll
methods.description: Polls for NFC-A and ISO-DEP presence.

methods.name: SendApdu
methods.description: Sends an APDU command to a specified receiver.

methods.name: CasimirController (private constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the controller with an established socket.

methods.name: SelectNfcA
methods.description: Selects NFC-A and returns sender ID.

methods.name: SelectT4AT
methods.description: Selects T4AT NFC platform using ISO-DEP protocol.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes an RF packet to the socket.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads a specific number of bytes with a timeout.

methods.name: ReadRfPacket
methods.description: Reads an RF packet from the socket.
